snapshot.text: Public Single Health System (SUS) alongside social security funds, described by the government as near collapse. The new government's National Health Plan 2026–2030 centres on primary care and integrated health networks.

priorities.title: National Health Plan 2026–2030
priorities.text: A 're-engineering' of the health system with primary care as the cross-cutting axis.

priorities.title: Integrated service networks
priorities.text: Bolivia wants to consolidate integrated health service networks to guarantee access.

priorities.title: Paying dialysis providers
priorities.text: The ministry acknowledged Bs 500 million in debts to dialysis centres and promised gradual payment.
